items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts.
items.why: Calf blood clot; first game missed.
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts; offense limited but top pass-catchers healthy.
items.opportunity: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks elevated in McKee offense.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday per ETR Sunday injury roundup.
items.why: Ankle injury; ruled out by team/coaches.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; Ravens pass game downgraded.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely with Huntley.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers.
items.why: Hamstring; no practice and official ruling.
items.implication: PHI RB room thin with Shipley also OUT; backup committee or Pierce elevated.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and carry share to remaining backs; pass-catchers may see more work.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR expecting 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy despite thin RB.
items.why: Practice reports and designations; high-ankle doubt for Henderson.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean play on probable Qs; fade PIT depth WRs; start PHI pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Warren possible TE1 upside if plays; Metcalf heavy targets in 2-WR.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and CeeDee Lamb listed IN; cleared for Sunday.
items.implication: Smith returns with McKee; Lamb full go for DAL.
items.opportunity: Smith high target share in PHI pass game; Lamb WR1 volume.

items.text: AJ Brown QUESTIONABLE; practiced limited all week.
items.why: Ankle; limited practice but earlier than expected.
items.implication: Game-time; possible return boosts NE pass game.
items.opportunity: If active, high target share; else backups.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game.
items.why: Cleared; no designation on final report.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected vs KC.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams.
items.implication: ARI RB depth chart shifts to backups.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining Cardinals RBs.

items.text: Jets once again have ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Patriots.
items.why: Quad; third straight miss, no practice.
items.implication: Braelon Allen handles primary load again.
items.opportunity: Full RB1 opportunity for Allen handcuff.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and ruled out vs Jaguars.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries for remaining Texans RBs.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Soft matchup vs WSH secondary; high ranking.
items.opportunity: Elite target/red-zone opportunity in favorable spot.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for usage; Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) elite recent usage and soft run D.
items.why: Bankable usage for London; volume and matchup for Kyren.
items.implication: Start with confidence as high-end options.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) tough matchup; Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34) shaky QB/feed.
items.why: Ugly matchups and limited recent production.

items.text: LOVE Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2) high-scoring; HATE Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23) toughest pass D and timid play.
items.why: Purdy soft matchup/total; Nix historical timid + elite D.
items.opportunity: Purdy pass volume vs weak secondary.
